title: Winter and Portrait
author: Noor Crane
blurb: Isandro Ravensworth, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
